question:
Select the option that depicts how the given transparent sheet of paper would appear if it is folded at the dotted line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a225c201bf4182ce7c98128549fe6758b1ed4b648cb8129590f92ebb9b5039.png]
solution:
When the sheet is folded at the dotted lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a225c201bf4182ce7c98128549fe6758b1ed4b648cb8129590f92ebb9b5039.png] 

The figure on the right side will appear on the left side after folding on the dotted line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a164c1f45e29bc0fe9f7c8064f3aa51f282e8653dd233de247cb2863ed22a9aa.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e337f4f5bf5ec9825e4de52e2be575d2b91f560870bb333129879e5aed9af81.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
